content.title: iShares Silver Trust Suffers One of Worst Days in Years
content.summary: The iShares Silver Trust, the largest silver exchange-traded fund, ended 7.2% lower amid a broader sell-off in precious metals.  Known by its ticker SLV, the fund is a popular way for investors and traders to wager on silver prices without having to store piles of precious metals.

content.title: Silver Prices Suffer Biggest One-Day Fall Since 2021, Gold Also Drops
content.summary: Precious metals prices fell sharply Monday after exchange operator CME Group required traders to put down more cash on their bets in the volatile gold and silver markets.  Gold futures dropped 4.5% Monday, while silver futures slid 8.7%, their largest decline since February 2021.  The price reversal came after CME raised margin requirements across a range of metals contracts.
